collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — INNER LIFE, PART VII (121-140, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: Two friends who used to meet every day now live on opposite sides of the village: walk over, or wave.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) and (friend) used to see each other every day. Now (friend) has moved to a hut on the other side of the village, and they keep missing each other. They both still mean to visit. Somehow, a week has gone by. Today (subject) catches a glimpse of (friend) far away across the fields.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (subject) puts down (subject.his/her) basket and walks all the way across the fields. (friend) sees (subject.him/her) coming and starts walking too. They meet in the middle, both slightly out of breath. "I've been meaning to visit," they both say at once. They make a plan to meet at the halfway tree every few days. Mostly, they manage it.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) waves, a big wave with both arms. Far away, (friend) waves back the same way. It's not the same as talking. But it's something. (subject) goes back to work feeling a bit less far away. That evening (subject.he/she) walks over to the other side of the village after all, just to say hello.
